title: Anthropic, OpenAI tokens plunge as AI firms say pre-IPO share transfers are invalid
summary: Tokens on Solana that claim to track the private-market valuations of Anthropic and OpenAI dropped sharply this week after both AI companies warned that the structures used to back the tokens may be invalid.
